routes: /proxmox (Overview tab): the nodes table, served by a mock-mode backend built from this change with the frontend embedded, on a private port on pulse-dev.
states: Mock estate: 50 Proxmox nodes, every node carrying stored temperature history.
Bars + History hover (the default): a hovered node row shows CPU, memory, disk and temperature sparklines; the row stays 33px high, like its neighbours.
Pointer leaves the row: bars and the temperature gauge return, and no row keeps the lens.
Trends: every node row charts temperature (43px line in the 88px Temp column at 1600px).
Bars + Details hover: hovering a node row keeps the bars, and the page made no /api/charts/infrastructure request.
768px with a mouse (columns Node, CPU, Mem, Disk, Temp, Age): hovering Analytics B shows all four sparklines, the row stays 33px, and the temperature line is 62px wide.
API: metrics=cpu,temperature returned temperature for all 50 nodes and 77 agent hosts; the default payload carried no temperature series.
interactions: Hovered Analytics B, then hovered inside the CPU sparkline: tooltip with time and CPU value.
Hovered inside the temperature sparkline: tooltip 'Temperature 45°C', accessible label 'Analytics B temperature history, current 45°C'.
Moved the pointer off the table and confirmed no row kept data-history-lens-active.
limits: Mock temperatures are nearly flat, so a real spike shape was not seen; the scale for a 60-to-94°C spike is covered by a unit test.
Hover previews do not run on touch, so phone widths (which use touch) were not checked for the lens.
